2608.06992.title: GPTKB 2.0: Browsing, Querying, and Auditing a Disambiguated LLM-Derived Knowledge Base
2608.06992.paper_summary: We present a web demo for exploring a large-scale disambiguated knowledge base (KB) materialized from a large language model (LLM). GPTKB 2.0 contains 38.4M triples over 1.6M canonical entities, together with 207.6K consolidated relations and 66K consolidated classes. Unlike prior LLM-derived knowledge bases that largely identify entities by surface strings, GPTKB 2.0 performs context-guided disambiguation during recursive KB construction, separating homonyms and merging synonymous mentions as facts are elicited. The demo makes this process inspectable: users can browse entities, follow links across the KB, and audit the provenance of individual facts, including surface forms, candidate matches, source triples, and disambiguation decisions. The interface further supports structured SPARQL queries, natural-language questions translated to SPARQL, and entity linking from user-provided text to canonical GPTKB 2.0 entries. GPTKB 2.0 is available at https://gptkb.org/, with the full KB downloadable for offline use.
2608.06992.paper_summary_zh: 我們展示了一個網頁演示，用於探索一個由大型語言模型（LLM）實現的大規模消歧義知識庫（KB）。GPTKB 2.0 包含 3840 萬個三元組，涵蓋 160 萬個標準實體，以及 20.76 萬個整合關係和 6.6 萬個整合類別。與之前的 LLM 衍生知識庫主要通過表面字符串識別實體不同，GPTKB 2.0 在遞歸 KB 構建過程中執行上下文引導的消歧義，分離同名詞並在事實被引出時合併同義提及。該演示使這一過程可檢查：用戶可以瀏覽實體，跟隨 KB 中的鏈接，並審核個別事實的來源，包括表面形式、候選匹配、來源三元組和消歧義決策。該界面還支持結構化的 SPARQL 查詢、翻譯為 SPARQL 的自然語言問題，以及從用戶提供的文本到標準 GPTKB 2.0 條目的實體鏈接。GPTKB 2.0 可在 https://gptkb.org/ 獲得，完整的 KB 可下載以供離線使用。
